name: 10062-sharedprefix-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, bf16. Complete in the local HF cache -- nothing to download.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One GPU, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, dense, 36 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads (GQA), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16: 8.19B parameters = 16.4 GB of weights, 144 KiB of KV per token.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 1200 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, SINGLE TURN. One shared prefix of 512 tokens (`prefix_count: 1`), byte-identical on every request, followed by a question of ~64 tokens (stdev 24, clamped 24-160), generating ~120 tokens (stdev 48, clamped 16-512). Seed 42.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter help-desk assistant answering 32 concurrent short questions that share one long instruction prefix on a single GPU.
launch:
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
context-length: 8192
random-seed: 42
